description: Five reposts of one Acme Wire press release across five outlets. Acceptance test: syndicated copies count as exactly ONE originating stream, never five. Three members share an independenceKey, two do not, proving the union of wire-origin + copied title/lead signals merges transitively.

sources.title: Acme GridScale announces 400 MWh grid battery pilot in three provinces
sources.lead: Acme GridScale today announced a 400 MWh grid-scale battery pilot across three provinces, with construction starting in October 2026 and first dispatch expected in 2027.
